summary: EESTI ENERGIA AS (LEI 5493005044RTLQ5RZU70; Estonian registry code 10421629) is identifier-confirmed and registered in Estonia. The Government of Estonia holds a shareholding per OpenSanctions and is additionally recorded as a controlling owner on Wikidata, making this a possible state-owned enterprise — a structural indicator noted at medium confidence from a Wikidata-sourced, presence-only signal, not a determination of state control. The Estonian e-Business Register records four current board members (Andrus Durejko and Marlen Tamm from 2023-04-03, Lauri Karp from 2024-09-10, and Gerrit Mäesalu from 2026-06-22), and related party Jürgen Ligi is flagged at high confidence as a politically exposed person by both OpenSanctions and EveryPolitician. GLEIF data indicates the ownership chain contains an anonymous entity (opaque ownership, medium confidence) and reaches into at least one non-EU/EEA jurisdiction — Jordan (JO) — giving rise to high-confidence structural indicators for non-EU jurisdiction exposure and complex corporate structure meeting AMLA CDD RTS thresholds, while the chain also has three corporate layers (complex ownership layers, medium confidence). Material limitations include a GLEIF reporting exception whereby an unknown parent does not consolidate EESTI ENERGIA AS, leaving the ultimate beneficial owner unresolved, and OpenSanctions data is licensed CC-BY-NC-4.0, restricting commercial re-use.
